how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, the named suite run against it, then the file restored before the next row (X14/X15's convention: `before` is the shipped source the row was run against and `after` the text that replaced it). Device rows ran on lease G23-zcs2m, pair-b (iPhone Air / iOS 27 and emulator-5570 / API 35); the filtered gate names satisfy nothing but their own name. Rows marked `organic` are not mutations: they are a new test going red against the real bug before its fix, which is the stronger evidence, and the logs are in `gate.mjs logs --branch task/G23-icon-button`. Rows 1-4 share one build and one run, so one red line is attributed to each of them by which assertion failed. Fix round 1 (rows with "round": 1) ran on lease G23-g3zrq, pair-a (`iPhone 17` / iOS 27 and emulator-5574 / API 35); rows that say "with … one run, one red line each" share a build and a run, and each is attributed by which assertion failed.

mutations.note: The point of the wider net: the debt is not only an exemption the device run prints. It is a failing cell in the coverage matrix, so removing the row cannot quietly make a component look covered - the matrix, the runner and the a11y list all go red together. And a row that stops matching goes red through staleExemptions instead of quietly expiring.

mutations.mutation: not a mutation: the helper's own shape guard fired against this task's callsite. The barrier at the end of the check waited on the toggle's value echo ("on") and passed atLeast as well, which is a counter-only option — so tapUntilValue refused the combination rather than guess at it
redTests: icon-button: FAIL (no retries) — failed: the barrier tap on the enabled toggle: atLeast needs a counter, and "on" is not one
mutations.note: The full Android real-input pass is the first honest run of this check (the earlier filtered Android run in the ledger is the double-fire mutation, red by design), and it is what found the misuse. Fixed by dropping atLeast — "on" has no "or more", and the chip barrier keeps its atLeast because that one waits on a press counter, where a stalled tap landing with its retry proves the claim twice. The fixed check is green in real-input:android:--control:icon-button (666s) with the line "the enabled toggle, tapped the same way, still answers — expected on, saw on".
